nodes.text: this deed. Finngeir gave Grim the farm that he had been managing,
with all its goods, land and livestock. Grim's wound went
badly, and his leg swelled up. One evening there came
a woman, who said she was a healer. She asked to bind up the wound
of Grim, and so it was that she bound it, and vanished away. A little
later a swelling came into Grim's leg, all the way up into the belly.
Then a priest was sent for, and he received the last rites
and then died. And this woman was called Gefjun
the Sorceress, and had been Gaus's mistress.
That winter passed. And in the spring Finngeir bought
